## Checklist (CONTRIBUTING.md)

- [ ] The design document was updated **first** (requirement IDs, commands, formats), and its version bumped
- [ ] The code implements exactly what the design document now says
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has a test, listed in the design document's Tests table
- [ ] `python tests/run_tests.py` passes (or the CI run is green)
- [ ] Firmware `FW_VERSION` bumped and `CHANGELOG.md` row added
- [ ] Hardware status stated honestly: "tested on <arm> <date>" or "NOT YET RUN ON HARDWARE"
